title: The first boss.
note: Cleared island, 14 Thornwalls (auto maze), 14 Sporelings at rank 4 + 6 Dewdrops at rank 5 (ranks tune damage without moving the auto placements; counts do move them). The Stag walks the whole route from 2.5 s and is dispelled ~6-9 cells from the Heartwood at ~24.5-26 s (residual randomness) (main 8459d82b). Dewdrops at rank 4 is a knife edge (1-3% hp at the door, then it reaches the tree).
captions: The first boss: the Hollow Stag.
On a straight line, it charges.
So bend the maze. Every corner breaks the charge.
A few tiles from the tree. It never got its run-up.
